scenes.head: Debt service cover: 1.25x
scenes.src: Illustrative numbers, not a real company.
scenes.say: The debt service coverage ratio compares the cash a business generates with the loan principal and interest due over the same period. Here, fifteen hundred against twelve hundred: one point two five times.

Below one times, the cash generated doesn't cover the repayments. Each lender sets its own minimum and its own definition, usually in the facility letter. Test it twelve months ahead before you borrow more.
